readmeExcerpt: This sample shows the smallest useful patterns for storing Java `UUID` primary keys in Oracle AI Database with plain JDBC and Spring Data JPA.
highlights: Java UUID values can be stored compactly as RAW(16) primary keys.
The conversion is explicit and bit-preserving.
JDBC can bind and read the value as bytes without string formatting.
Spring Data JPA can persist and find entities by UUID while Oracle AI Database stores the id as RAW(16).
metaTitle: JDBC and JPA UUID Primary Keys | Oracle AI Database Code Samples
metaDescription: JDBC and Spring Data JPA sample that stores Java UUID primary keys as RAW(16) values in Oracle AI Database.
